text:
maya: CI flagged a regression on the quantized-2b candidate — summarization suite avg ROUGE-L dropped 95 -> 89. CI job: <https://ci.redwood/runs/3821> :worried:
andre: on it. which commit/branch is the candidate from? any tokenizer changes?
maya: model-onboard/quant-2b/2026-03-18, commit f2a9b3. no tokenizer changes in that branch.
ci-bot: build 3821 finished. artifacts: <https://artifacts.redwood/3821/logs.txt>. diff: <https://ci.redwood/diff/3821>
lia: saw something similar when we enabled fused-layernorm kernels in runtime (PR #1547). int8 precision drift is possible.
andre: good call. i'll run a small bisect matrix: float32 baseline vs int8 quant with/without fused-layernorm and with/without kv-warm.
maya: started a local matrix (quick):
```
# runner command
python eval_runner.py --suite summarization --model baseline.float32 --model quant-2b.int8 --warm_kv True --seed 42
```
tom: heads-up — CI runner docker image bumped torch 2.2.0 -> 2.2.1 on 2026-03-17. could be kernel-level numerical changes.
lia: re-ran a quick smoke: quant-2b int8 on the old-runtime image matches baseline within ~1pt. on the new-runtime image it's ~-6pt. runtime image looks suspect.
andre: can we reproduce deterministically? if yes, we should roll the eval canary back until we root cause. also open rollback ticket for the runtime image.
maya: opening rollback RFC for canary, pinging infra. @ryan can you take image ownership?
ryan: eng-infra here — initiating rollback of eval runner image tag to torch-2.2.0. will update when complete.
ci-bot: rollback job 3850 started. ETA ~8m. logs: <https://ci.redwood/job/3850>
lia: :thumbsup: after rollback i'll re-run the full summarization suite and post numbers.
ryan: rolled back the eval runners to torch-2.2.0, new jobs should pick up the old image.
ci-bot: job 3855 (post-rollback summarization run) completed, results show metric delta within noise — regression cleared. artifacts: <https://artifacts.redwood/3855/results.json>
maya: great. next steps: add a CI guard to pin the runtime image for eval jobs and an alert for >3pt ROUGE-L drop on ensemble suites. also add a targeted test for fused-layernorm + int8 combos.
andre: i'll PR a CI change to pin the image and add the alert rule. i'll also add a small integration test exercising fused-layernorm int8 numerics.
lia: filing a follow-up issue to investigate 2.2.1 kernel differences and coordinate with runtime/kernel owners — assigning to runtime team.
maya: thanks all, closing the immediate canary blocker. we'll coordinate longer-term fix in the kernel/quant stack.
